name: Móra d'Ebre (Spain)
description: White field with a dark blue wavy stripe near the lower edge, charged at the centre with a dark green fruited mulberry tree.
history: The official flag of Móra d'Ebre is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with a dark blue wavy fess of half, three and a half crests of thickness 1/14 of the height set at 1/7 from the lower edge, and the dark green fruited mulberry of the arms; approved on 14 April 2010 and published in the DOGC on 3 May 2010.

features.role: wavy fess of three and a half crests set at 1/7 from the lower edge
